delivery_names.note: The launcher is an extensionless native ELF64 executable; library filenames retain .dll. No Wine dependency.

font.calibration: All non-ASCII reference and catalog glyphs share the maximum size fitting the existing 9 logical-pixel ink and 10 logical-pixel line budgets. ASCII retains the native bitmap font and does not constrain this outline font's envelope.
font.tracking: Each non-ASCII glyph token advances by its measured logical width plus 2 logical pixels. Surface and renderer measurement/drawing share this advance, including the final cell; native centering, wrapping, buttons and cursors consume the same result. ASCII retains its native 8-pixel advance. This spacing change does not complete the pending native shadow style envelope.

scope: Startup/loading, introduction/poem, main menu/footer, About, Credits, setup display fields, saved-character empty messages/title, character-creation menu/culture/sex/name/season, portrait help and attribute confirmation, ancestor controls, Village source records, main-game HUD/calendar/world labels at individually recorded native calls. All 312 GAME.NFO encyclopedia topics (313 source records), culture-selection previews, encyclopedia heading/navigation/help and both map culture legends at native display consumers. All eleven farewell fields at endgame's native panel, showtext, centext and button calls. MagicProfile title, 25 spell names and descriptions, initial/general/instant guidance, exit and encyclopedia footer at native texture builders.
ownership: Native UI retains layout, wrapping, centering, controls, input, hit testing, background, caching and animation. Chinese glyphs draw synchronously inside native text leaves; no pixel tracking or text replay.

language_redraw.main_menu: Shift+F10 rebuilds the native background/footer fragment 0x15ceeb..0x15cf44, peli_info at 0x15cbe0, LIST_Draw, MENUBUFFER and current selection before Flip. MakeStartList and LIST_Reset are not re-entered; original entries and selection remain native.
language_redraw.about_and_credits: Rebuild the main menu, replace the owner's SCREENSAVE through save_page at 0x13d590, then rebuild the active native view with its input wait skipped. The original restore_page at view exit consumes the updated background.
language_redraw.ownership: The same native reconstruction is used for main-menu resize. No UI coordinates, page snapshots, pixel tracking or deferred glyph operations are stored by this refresh path.

font_redraw: A render-module or adapter-module change invalidates glyph widths and requests native reconstruction at the next input-poll return for the main menu or About/Credits. Scenario selection and confirmation use their confirmed LIST_Go input-return reconstruction. Other owners consume the new metrics on native reconstruction; no page is replayed or input synthesized.

native_density.resources: Native screen, BufSurface, SCREENSAVE, SCREENBUFFY, GAMESAVE, MENUBUFFER, named grabsurface caches, fade surfaces and HeadingBoxSurface/HeadingBoxSoftRen share the canvas output ratio. Asset pixel domains retain their original dimensions.
native_density.density_source: Window-target logical presentation scale or SDL_GetRendererOutputSize at confirmed native creation/main-menu boundaries; native 800x600 raster remains the minimum when output is smaller.

pending_boundaries: Resize-driven complete screen reconstruction is established for the main menu only. The map culture legend and MapviewMainTex obtain current output density at native map rebuild. Other active pages keep the last established screen density until the next main-menu boundary; old bitmap caches are not text-replayed.
Linux showtext preserves its four native shadow calls, but the shadow budget is not yet propagated into font calibration and external width calls. This style envelope remains pending.
Pure refresh of setup body, already-dimmed profile panels, saved-character windows, ancestor pages and current Village page remains tied to native reconstruction.

Attribute confirmation consumes Chinese at native construction. Its frameless list has no independent erasing redraw; the complete draw_profile function also resets the list, waits for input and writes REROLL. Immediate whole-page refresh is not established, and neither that function nor character_creation is replayed for language changes or hot publication.

Encyclopedia keyword editing defers language reconstruction until native getst returns; the in-progress editor is not replayed. The translated No_Info notice keeps its opening language until the native key wait ends; FIRST TIMER INFO supports native reconstruction. Map culture legends consume the current language at native map reconstruction.

Farewell consumes the selected language at its native construction calls. Its wait loop has no confirmed pure redraw entry; Shift+F10 does not reconstruct already drawn farewell pixels. endgame is never re-entered for refresh because it owns music, fades, input waiting and process exit.

MagicProfile consumes language and current window density at native reconstruction; the selected description consumes them at CompileInfoboxRitualList. Immediate whole-page language or hot-publication refresh is not established. MagicProfile is not replayed because it owns list reset, music, input and spell selection; existing pixels stay native until reconstruction.

hot_reload.transport: Linux abstract AF_UNIX stream: NUL + uwcn-<effective UID>-<PID>; same-UID SO_PEERCRED
hot_reload.publication: PREPARE -> ReadyToPublish -> archive old formal files -> replace formal files -> COMMIT -> Applied with SHA-256 and generation
hot_reload.dispatch: Short Before / resident native call / short After; stable slot lookup after native input and animation waits
hot_reload.state: Language, input scopes, native glyph alphabet, semantic invocation state and native resource density metadata; no retained UI pixels or text replay
hot_reload.migration: Startup-only Linux ABI 1 resident cannot migrate in place. ABI 2 loads through the formal launcher on the next normal start; subsequent compatible business publication works at resident SDL control boundaries.

runtime_verification: Not performed; launching the game, running artifacts and tests are prohibited.

character_name_input.scope: Choose_Name at 0x1e1e4 calls the existing getst editor; other input callers retain their original event behavior.
character_name_input.text_event: 0xf6e82 consumes the complete UTF-8 already copied by native SDL_TEXTINPUT handling. Native getkey -2 return bypasses processed_keysym; getst consumes the text at 0x1403ff after erasing its cursor.
character_name_input.editing: Backspace at 0x1404db removes one complete scalar; native erase calls 0x140481/0x1406ba/0x140727 consume measured width. Native Enter, Escape, TAB/random-name, underscore and Flip remain in control.
character_name_input.ime: sdl2-compat/SDL3 native composition and candidate UI; input rectangle derives from getst's cursor call 0x14038b and current renderer/window transform. No Mod composition overlay.
character_name_input.storage: Plr.name remains 13 bytes including NUL, with getst's 12-byte payload and original minimum of 3 bytes. UTF-8 names and paths persist without display tokens. Typical Chinese characters use 3 bytes, allowing up to 4; mixed names share the byte budget.
character_name_input.display: UTF-8 converts to transient glyph tokens only at native text/width boundaries, including showtext copy 0x13e8ef and renshowtext copy 0x13e324, before legacy byte remapping. Native target density and cache ownership remain unchanged.
character_name_input.case_and_path: StrUpr 0xf91f0 and StrLwr 0xf9378 retain complete UTF-8 scalars; Choose_Name final path encoding at 0x1e31d preserves UTF-8. Original ASCII/legacy path conversion and file-existence checks remain native.

spells.density: 0x10672d scopes the native CreateGamesizeTex tail call; 0x106a65 creates the native description target. Both receive current window density at their confirmed construction boundaries. character_season_and_portrait.help: 0x1c314 and 0x1efa9 -> SANATAULUKKO_Lisaa(1, text): starting-season guidance and portrait-selection prompt. Existing paragraph width, cursor and glyph extensions consume the full encoded strings.

character_season_and_portrait.ownership: Native menu mode 8, button prefixes, blank separator, selection geometry, mouse hit areas, portrait navigation and original season effects remain unchanged. Synchronous glyphs use the established native screen density.

character_attributes.owner: draw_profile at 0x10d5d0, reached with mode 1 from character_creation; PROFILE_SCR at 0x10d470 owns the background and two group panels.
character_attributes.identity: 0x10d610 -> FullSubScreen borrows the original name prefix from plrnam and translates the inhabitant suffix with profile.culture_0..9. choose_culture at 0x1c0bf stores the culture index at Plr+0xD (0xac8604d); 0x1c0d6/0x1c0df copy CULTURE_INHABITANT[index] into Plr+0xE. Keep the stored name, culture index and original inhabitant string unchanged; TekstiPalkki mode 5 uses the existing complete-text centering and glyph path.
character_attributes.age: 0x10d641 -> __sprintf_chk: the native R8 age is inserted into Chinese in the original 1024-byte display buffer, before native textwidth at 0x10d66d and showtext at 0x10d692. Mode 0 lifetime prose is outside this change.
character_attributes.labels: Four winbox title calls, eleven desced_stat labels and two showtext labels borrow Chinese without changing positions, statbar arguments or portrait resources.
character_attributes.units: 0x10d95e and 0x10d9da -> TekstiPalkki: translate only the native UnitString_Length/Weight suffix. Preserve the exact native numeric string, unit selection, rounding and precision.
character_attributes.confirmation: 0x10db12/0x10db20 -> SANATAULUKKO_Lisaa for the two confirmation records; mode 2 explanatory records at 0x10da8a/0x10da98 use the same native paragraph route.

LIST_AdvStyle(1,0) changes text style only; length-based highlight remains disabled by LIST_Reset.
character_attributes.drawing: Existing native screen density, title centering, paragraph width, cursor advancement and synchronous glyph output. Native UI retains background, list geometry, hit testing, caches and presentation; existing page pixels wait for native reconstruction.

culture_information.links: Complete native English aliases retain their lookup identity. Multiword names are atomic display units; Chinese scalar tokens and aliases use the same conversion at native measurement and drawing calls. culture_information.drawing: Native screen output-density path for encyclopedia/previews/legacy map. Modern map legend uses the native surface at return 0x10ac3b, CultureDialogTexture, MapviewMainTex and window at matching output density; synchronous glyph rendering only.
culture_information.map_legends: Eleven culture names and both titles at kulttuuri_info(0x108940) and compile_CultureDialogTexture(0x10ac10). Native map reconstruction at 0x10b0c6 rebuilds the legend and its full-resolution target; native layout, colors and resource ownership remain unchanged.
culture_information.language: Shift+F10 reconstructs the current topic, encyclopedia heading, help and navigation through native builders. It suppresses history insertion and nested input only during reconstruction and restores the original action/topic selection. Scope::attributes remains 10; encyclopedia_keyword, encyclopedia_intro and encyclopedia_notice are appended as 11, 12 and 13.

world_generation.owner: kartta_main 0x7eb60, rndworld_screen 0x7e7f0 and NaytaMittakaava 0x7bb50; native screen, list, input and MENUBUFFER remain game-owned.
world_generation.title: 0x7e856 -> winbox borrows the Chinese title and retains all seven native arguments, including flags 0x20 and the native left-aligned title branch.
world_generation.controls: 0x7ed4f/0x7ed6a/0x7ee55/0x7ee70/0x7ee8b/0x7eea6/0x7eec1/0x7eedc -> LIST_ButtonSpotEntry borrow the original ASCII key prefix and a translated suffix. Native textwidth, full-character drawing, selection and mouse geometry consume the same complete label. Arrow controls and original actions are preserved.
world_generation.scale: 0x7bbb1/0x7bc69 -> __sprintf_chk retain the original computed R8D integer and 100-byte buffer, translating only the format. 0x7bc27 translates the scale label. Native boxes, scale line, zoom arithmetic and units remain unchanged.
world_generation.refresh: After a compatible adapter reload or language change, the next native first-button call rebuilds rndworld_screen and only the native fragments 0x7ed00..0x7ed30 and 0x7ec18..0x7ec61. Native R15 preserves legend visibility; native LIST_Position/Set_LIST_Position preserve selection. Original button calls recreate geometry and the next LIST_Go owns its cache. No world generation, RNG, starting-location search or input wait is re-entered.
world_generation.density: Existing density-aware native software screen and caches; glyphs are rasterized synchronously in native text calls. No page coordinate table, pixel tracking or text replay is introduced. Immediate reconstruction during an already pending LIST_Go wait remains unconfirmed; refresh waits for the next native control-building pass. Existing non-main-menu resize and shadow-budget limitations remain.

scenario_selection.title: 0x1d17b -> draw_campselgfx borrows the Chinese title before the original 1024-byte copy, background dimming and seven-argument winbox.

scenario_selection.paragraphs: 0x1d271 -> SANATAULUKKO_Lisaa borrows each of 13 complete summaries; 0x1d2f5/0x1d303 borrow the two footer records. Chinese scalar word tokens use the existing software paragraph width, spacing, cursor and glyph extensions; original reset/append flags, wrapping, line spacing and colors remain native.
scenario_selection.refresh: At 0xf871f after LIST_Go getkey returns naturally, the original caller at native RSP+0x458 identifies 0x1d365, including pages opened before publication. Rebuild SelectCampaign only through 0x1d30a, then resume its balanced epilogue 0x1d332. During this redraw only, crtplr_info(0) skips unused random(20) at 0x1bbfc. No input wait, scenario assignment or get_camp/story write is re-entered.
scenario_selection.cache_and_selection: Native LIST_Position/Set_LIST_Position preserve the current selection; original background, title, rows and footer rebuild first, followed by save_menubuf, LIST_Highlight and Flip. The actual getkey result is preserved. Refresh consumes adapter reload, dependency invalidation or language change at the next natural input-return boundary; it does not synthesize an event or claim immediate visual completion from Applied.
scenario_selection.density: Existing native screen output-density target; glyphs draw synchronously inside native component calls. No page coordinates, text snapshots, pixel tracking or deferred replay. Existing non-main-menu resize and shadow-budget limitations remain pending.

scenario_confirmation.refresh: At existing LIST_Go input-return hook 0xf871f, caller 0x1cfd5 at original RSP+0x458 identifies this confirmation page. Re-enter only native fragment 0x1cefc..0x1cf7e, returning through the last button hook; no get_camp file writes, input wait, random values or selection result handling run during redraw. scenario_confirmation.cache_and_selection: The native background, image, title, word table and controls rebuild; LIST_Position/Set_LIST_Position preserve selection, followed by native save_menubuf, LIST_Highlight and Flip. Actual input RAX is retained. Hot reload, dependency changes and language switching request redraw at the next natural getkey return; Applied is not a visual completion receipt.
scenario_confirmation.density: Glyphs draw synchronously into the existing density-aware native screen. No UI position tables, page snapshots, pixel tracking or text replay. Existing non-main-menu resize and native shadow-budget limitations remain pending.
scenario_confirmation.state: Existing state-v1 scenario_record/village fields and Host ABI 2 remain unchanged. The current thirteen-way story ID is reconstructed from the native title inside each synchronous show_scenario call; it is not a saved page snapshot. The old single-scenario keys are replaced together with Adapter through one catalog/adapter publication transaction.
